$comment: CI-Hub dynamic compose (dynamicComposeSchema). The viewer is the user-facing app (port 8080): a static nginx bundle from viewer-react/Dockerfile, whose VITE_* values are inlined at build time, so per-install Memory wiring reaches it as ?memory=/?token= URL params instead of service env. companion-atlas-api (port 8787) hosts the REST and MCP surface the Hub wires to via agents.mcp; its image is built from server/Dockerfile. publish-image.yml publishes both images to GHCR.
